title: Use-after-free on a session token
root_cause: free() releases the memory back to the allocator, but the pointer still points at it. Reading or writing through that pointer afterward touches memory the program no longer owns.
defenses: Set pointers to NULL immediately after free() and never dereference them again.
Document and enforce a single clear owner for every heap allocation.
Run AddressSanitizer or Valgrind in testing -- both catch use-after-free directly.
Prefer a hardened allocator in production (e.g. scudo) that mitigates UAF exploitation.
